_meta.description: Contract Review Board policy — configurable thresholds and approver routing (KICKOFF §9.5). Illustrative editable defaults: 45% margin floor; VP/SVP/CFO deal-size tiers at $100M / $1B; auto-escalation on uncapped liability, MFN, warrant/equity, payment terms beyond net-60, and take-or-pay below a 70% floor. The policy engine evaluates every deal version against these rules.

rules.description: Blended gross margin must meet the 45% floor (cash/commercial view).
Committed value routes to an approver tier: <=$100M VP, <=$1B SVP, >$1B CFO.
Any uncapped liability exposure (e.g. uncapped IP indemnification) escalates.
A most-favored-nation clause escalates (portfolio repricing exposure).
An equity/warrant component escalates (contra-revenue, dilution, ASC 606/718).
Payment terms beyond net-60 escalate (working-capital drag).
Take-or-pay floor below 70% escalates (insufficient revenue protection).
